title: Plan Mode: the read-only restriction for MCP tools depends on an unverified, server-controlled annotation

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a detailed security and UX bug report regarding unverified MCP server 'readOnlyHint' annotations in Plan Mode. It includes exact code locations, reproduction steps, and a clear proposal to display provenance warnings during confirmation.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Addressing this issue requires adding a clear provenance warning message in 'ToolConfirmationMessage.tsx' and passing the relevant annotation details in MCP confirmation types, alongside unit tests in 'ToolConfirmationMessage.test.tsx'. This is a localized UI and type enhancement.

summary.problem: Plan Mode relies on server-provided 'readOnlyHint' annotations to promote MCP tools to 'ask_user' confirmation. Unverified or malicious MCP servers can set 'readOnlyHint: true' on destructive tools, prompting the user for approval in Plan Mode without warning them that the read-only claim is server-supplied and unverified.
summary.root_cause: The Plan Mode policy in 'plan.toml' elevates MCP tools with 'readOnlyHint = true' to 'ask_user'. However, 'ToolConfirmationMessage.tsx' does not inform the user that the read-only status originates from the external MCP server and has not been verified by Gemini CLI.
summary.context: Although confirmation is still required before execution, users in Plan Mode expect tools offered for approval to be read-only. Displaying a provenance warning in the confirmation dialog informs the user of the unverified server assertion.

steps: Update 'packages/core/src/confirmation-bus/types.ts' and 'packages/core/src/tools/mcp-tool.ts' to pass MCP tool annotation metadata (such as 'readOnlyHint' or server read-only claim status) within the MCP confirmation details payload.

Modify 'packages/cli/src/ui/components/messages/ToolConfirmationMessage.tsx' to display a provenance warning notice when an MCP tool is presented for confirmation via 'readOnlyHint', informing the user that the tool's read-only claim was declared by the MCP server and is unverified.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: The tool confirmation UI displays an unverified read-only claim warning message when prompting the user for an MCP tool elevated by 'readOnlyHint'.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in 'ToolConfirmationMessage.test.tsx' that renders an MCP tool confirmation message with 'readOnlyHint' metadata and verifies the disclaimer warning text is displayed.
